CreateCustomerRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/customers` (PRD §4, RF-15). Only the company name is
required; an empty VAT number, tax code or address is stored as none. The company name and the
address are measured once trimmed, as the aggregate stores them, so their length is checked in
`Validate` rather than with a length attribute on the raw text.

CreateCustomerResponse.description: Response body for a successful `POST /api/registry/customers` request.

lastModifiedAt.description: UTC instant of the last change.

taxCode.description: The tax code in normal form, or `null`.

vatNumber.description: The VAT number in normal form, or `null`.

version.description: Version the client sends back with its next write on this customer.

CreateUserResponse.description: Response body for a successful `POST /api/identity/users` request.

role.description: The functional role assigned to the user.

status.description: The initial lifecycle status (always UserStatus.Active on creation).

CreateVehicleRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/vehicles` (PRD RF-26, RF-27). The description is
measured once trimmed, as the aggregate stores it, so its length is checked in
`Validate` rather than with a length attribute on the raw text.

CreateVehicleResponse.description: Response body for a successful `POST /api/registry/vehicles` request.

lastModifiedAt.description: UTC instant of the last change.

requiresTrailer.description: Whether a trip led by this vehicle must name a trailer.

version.description: Version the client sends back with its next write on this vehicle.

DeactivateCustomerRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/customers/{id}/deactivate`. `Version` is the version
the client read; the change is refused when the customer has changed since.

DecommissionVehicleRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/vehicles/{id}/decommission`. `Version` is the version
the client read; the change is refused when the vehicle has changed since.

DisableUserRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/identity/users/{id}/disable`. `Version` is the version
the client read; the change is refused when the user has changed since.

EnableUserRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/identity/users/{id}/enable`. `Version` is the version
the client read; the change is refused when the user has changed since.

GetCurrentUserResponse.description: The signed-in user as the database knows it now.

driverId.description: The linked Registry driver for a `Driver` user; null when unlinked or for any other role.

ReactivateCustomerRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/customers/{id}/reactivate`. `Version` is the version
the client read; the change is refused when the customer has changed since.

ReactivateVehicleRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/vehicles/{id}/reactivate`. `Version` is the version
the client read; the change is refused when the vehicle has changed since.

RefreshResponse.description: Response payload for a successful token refresh.

accessTokenExpiresAt.description: UTC expiry of the new access token.

refreshToken.description: New opaque refresh token (base64url, 43 chars). The old token is now invalid.

refreshTokenExpiresAt.description: UTC expiry of the new refresh token.

UpdateCustomerRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/registry/customers/{id}` (PRD §4, RF-15). `Version` is the
version the client read; the save is refused when the customer has changed since.

UpdateVehicleRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/registry/vehicles/{id}` (PRD RF-26, RF-27). `Version` is the
version the client read; the save is refused when the vehicle has changed since.

UserListItemDto.description: A single item in the paginated list of users.

UserRole.description:
Functional role assigned to a User. Drives both back-office
authorization policies and the strict driver/back-office data boundary
(drivers must never see pricing — see `docs/context.md` §1).

UserStatus.description:
Lifecycle state of a User. A disabled user cannot log in and
cannot change password; the back office enables/disables users via dedicated
commands (per RNF-02 revocation requirement).

VehicleListItemDto.description: A single item in the paginated list of vehicles.

requiresTrailer.description: Whether a trip led by this vehicle must name a trailer.

version.description: Version the client sends back with its next write on this vehicle.

VehicleStatus.description: Whether a Vehicle can be chosen for new trips (PRD §6.6, RF-29).

VehicleType.description: What role a Vehicle can play in a trip (PRD §5.2, RF-26).
